items.title: January 6, 2021 — claimed she feared for her life in her office
items.summary: AOC publicly stated she feared for her life during the January 6 Capitol riot. Her office is in a building connected to the Capitol by tunnel; she was not in the Capitol itself during the breach. She clarified in subsequent interviews that she hid in her office bathroom. Critics disputed the framing; she maintains the fear was real regardless of physical distance.

sources.name: Reuters Fact Check
sources.description: Fact check of timeline and building geography

items.title: Met Gala attendance (2021)
items.summary: AOC attended the 2021 Met Gala wearing a dress with "Tax the Rich" written on it. Critics noted the tension between the message and attending a $35,000-per-ticket event. AOC stated she attended as a working-class guest at the invitation of the designer and that her presence advanced political messaging.
